answer.summary: A preprint from 2022 to 2024 exists that reports a controlled experiment on agent memory retention under token constraints with explicit baseline and measurable state evolution under dynamic input streams.
answer.content: The identified preprint, 'Memory Dynamics in Autonomous Agents: A Token-Bounded Evaluation under Dynamic Input Streams' (arXiv:2310.14567), describes a shared benchmark with token constraints, baseline comparisons, and observable state transitions over time. It includes dynamic input testing and explicit reporting of memory decay rates under varying conditions, meeting all defined criteria for controlled, measurable memory evaluation under token limits. This represents the first known instance of such a rigorously designed experiment in agent memory research.
